reviewer: fresh LLM reviewer; not human or expert ground truth
method: Independent source-text reading. Claims describe textual commitments and their attribution, not truth or legal validity. No dataset schema, candidates, labels, audit implementation, documentation, or augmentation plan was read.
offset_convention: Python Unicode code point offsets, zero-based start and exclusive end, calculated against exact source_text.
global_notes: An unmentioned property is different from explicit uncertainty or a declared lack of knowledge.
Payment by a named person and existential payment for a parking stay are distinct claims. Not paying personally does not show that no one paid.
A vehicle can be the standing subject or target of parking; a person can be payer; a document can be evidential source. These roles cannot be substituted.
Reported document propositions, negated speech-act content, obligations, and hypothetical assumptions must retain their scope.
Same-episode readings based on discourse are distinguishable from explicit temporal or anaphoric identity.

cases.source_text: Я оплатил парковку. В письме: парковка не оплачена.

supported_claims.description: The narrator asserts that they paid for parking.
The letter contains an assertion that parking was not paid for.
supported_claims.target: parking stay referred to by letter
supported_claims.actuality: asserted by the document, not endorsed by narrator

persons: narrator is first payer and reporter of letter
letter author is not identified; the letter is evidential source, not the payer

cases.episode_relations: Normal discourse reading connects both clauses to the same parking stay, but that identity is inferred rather than expressly identified by time, vehicle, or episode ID.
unresolved_readings: A same-stay reading creates opposed source-level claims; another-stay or differently scoped payment reading remains possible.
The narrator reports the letter contents and need not endorse them.
unsupported_inferences: The narrator personally asserts both payment and nonpayment as facts.
The letter proves real nonpayment.
The vehicle is the letter or the narrator.
Same episode is an explicit textual identifier.

cases.source_text: Я оплатил парковку, а письмо утверждает, что парковка не оплачена.

supported_claims.description: The narrator asserts that they paid for parking.
The letter claims that parking was not paid for.
supported_claims.target: parking stay referred to by letter
supported_claims.actuality: asserted by the document, not endorsed by narrator

evidence.quote: письмо утверждает, что парковка не оплачена

persons: narrator is payer of first clause and reporter
letter/document is the source of the embedded negative claim

cases.episode_relations: The contrastive conjunction а strongly supports a common parking target across clauses; exact episode identity is a discourse resolution, not an explicit timestamp.
unresolved_readings: The text establishes a disagreement between sources on the natural shared-target reading; it does not resolve which account is true.
unsupported_inferences: Nonpayment is the narrator’s own accepted factual assertion.
The existence of a letter supplies a date, vehicle, paid-zone fact, or legal result.

cases.source_text: Я не мог не оплатить парковку.

supported_claims.description: The narrator says they could not avoid paying for parking / could not fail to pay.
supported_claims.polarity: outer inability applied to inner nonpayment
supported_claims.actuality: ordinary idiomatic reading strongly conveys completed payment, but modality is explicit

evidence.quote: Я не мог не оплатить парковку

persons: narrator is modal experiencer and intended/actual payer on the idiomatic reading

unresolved_readings: The idiomatic perfective reading usually presents payment as having happened because it was unavoidable.

A strictly modal reading asserts inability to avoid paying; simple actual-payment extraction requires an explicit annotation convention. It is not equivalent in form to an unmodalized statement Я оплатил.
The nature of the constraint is unspecified.
unsupported_inferences: Negative payment by cancelling only one не.
An explicit payment-memory unknown.
An independently stated plain factual negative or legal obligation.
A unique reason for the inability.

cases.source_text: Если бы я оплатил парковку, то сохранил бы чек.

Definite asserted nonpayment.
Actual receipt absence.
Explicit inability to know whether payment occurred.

Parking was not paid for.

cases.source_text: В постановлении: «ТС стояло в зоне ПП; оплаты нет».

supported_claims.description: An order/decision document states that a vehicle stood in a zone designated ПП.
supported_claims.actuality: asserted by document, not independently established by narrator

supported_claims.description: The same quoted document states that there is no payment.
supported_claims.target: payment context of quoted standing situation
supported_claims.actuality: asserted by document, not independently established by narrator

persons: document author/issuer and payer are unidentified
vehicles: ТС naturally expands to транспортное средство; vehicle is the subject of standing, not payer

cases.episode_relations: The two clauses inside one quote normally refer to one vehicle-parking situation; no explicit time or unique vehicle identifier is provided.
unresolved_readings: The expansion of ПП is not given; платная парковка is plausible in a parking diagnostic context but cannot be established from the source alone.
Оплаты нет naturally denies payment, but it may mean absent recorded/available payment depending on document context; no record-level qualification is explicit.
The text presents a document’s account, not verified real-world facts.
unsupported_inferences: ПП unambiguously means paid parking without an abbreviation convention.
The narrator is the driver/payer or accepts the quoted allegations.
The vehicle is a person or the payer.
A particular violation, law, fee, or legal validity is established.
